Title: [OT] Help to set up Outlook to view this group

Messages.Author: geo...@for.auth.gr
Messages.Body:
Can someone please let me know what do i need to set up a news account
with Outlook to view the group with it ?

e.g. what is the server address, e.t.c or where i can find this data.

note: i use outlook express to read my mail, but don't know how to set
up a news account and never tried to.

George

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
To use Outlook Express you need to:

1) contact your internet service provider or check their
website to find out their news server name.
Usually referred to as a NNTP server.

2) in Outlook express go to Tools > Accounts >
click on "Add" and you want to add a "News" account.

OE will then take you through a little wizard that
will collect info like the server name.

3)once set up it will usually ask if you want to
look at a list of groups now, find rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
on it and click subscribe.

You should be good to go.

I'm not sure it can be set up in Outlook, but Outlook Express works fine
as above. There may be other ways but this is what I use.

-JTP

Hey, I just picked George's email, since he was having trouble finding
out how to automatically include brackets on reply text, using Google

given article displayed in Google Groups, then hit the 'Reply' button
within the drop-down options given below the message header (NOT the
'Reply' link at the bottom of the message). Now you know. Easy as
pie...
